source_evidence_candidates.exact_quote:
1. The dependent variables are Likert scaled. Ordinary Least squares (OLS) is not appropriate
to analyse the Likert scaled data. Likert scaled variables are usually analysed using the
ordered probit or ordered logit model or structural equation modelling (see a standard
econometrics textbook, for instance Wooldridge or Greene). Given the sample size, I
suggest to use the ordered probit or ordered logit model.

In more detail, as the reviewer's suggestion for the analysis of the Likert scaled data. As the
reviewers' comments reached the authors at a point at which the analysis could not be
performed with a more appropriate model, the respective analysis has been removed
entirely from the manuscript.
